summary.text: The Standard Plan pays you for life, with higher starting payouts that stay level over time.

details.heading: Your premium
details.body: When you join CPF LIFE, all your Retirement Account savings become your CPF LIFE premium. Later money entering your Retirement Account automatically increases your premium and monthly payouts.

details.heading: Your monthly payouts
details.body: Your payouts are worked out using several factors and continue for as long as you live. The plan gives higher payouts at the start than the Escalating Plan, but they do not increase over time.

details.heading: Interest on your premium
details.body: Your CPF LIFE premium continues to earn CPF interest. This interest is included when your monthly payouts are worked out.

details.heading: After you pass away
details.body: Any remaining CPF LIFE premium balance is paid to your beneficiaries.

sources.page_title: How does the CPF LIFE Standard Plan work?

quotes.text: The CPF LIFE Standard Plan provides level payouts for life.
All your Retirement Account (RA) savings will be used as your CPF LIFE premium when you join CPF LIFE.
Compared to the CPF LIFE Escalating Plan, the Standard Plan provides higher payouts at the start, but don’t increase over time to keep up with the rising prices.
Your CPF LIFE premium will continue to earn CPF interest rates, which is factored into your monthly payouts.
Upon your passing, your remaining CPF LIFE premium balance will be paid to your beneficiaries.
